rationale: The assistant correctly recognised the dehumidifier as outside its nine appliance families and declined without inventing facts or suggesting parts, matching the expected out-of-scope handling. However it gave no pointer at all: it did not direct the customer to Meaco support or the manual, nor offer the easy general note that a cold garage and a humidity reading below target commonly explain no water collection, which the ground truth lists as acceptable directions. It was safe and honest but a bare refusal leaves the homeowner no better off than before, so overall usefulness is only adequate.
